package.name: house_cleaner_mission
package.description: Mission supervisor for the house cleaner robot. Runs the boustrophedon coverage mission, watches the battery, and orchestrates the dock (return-to-dock, creep, charge, undock) using the shared ``/battery_state`` / ``/dock/state`` / ``/dock/command`` / ``/dock/seated`` contract. Hardware-agnostic: the same node runs in the Gazebo sim and on the real TurtleBot3.
